image_description: A low-angle, black-and-white photograph of a street sign mounted on a pole. The sign is rectangular with rounded corners and features text that appears distorted and illegible, resembling gibberish or melting characters. The background shows bare tree branches and parts of a building against an overcast sky. The image has a grainy, high-contrast aesthetic.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text is completely illegible and structurally nonsensical. Characters merge into each other, have inconsistent baselines, and lack recognizable glyph structures. This is a classic AI generation failure in rendering text.

artifact_observations.location: Right edge of the sign and mounting area
artifact_observations.reasoning: The right side of the sign appears to warp or melt slightly into the background/pole area. The physical rigidity expected of a metal sign is compromised by soft, undefined edges.
The perspective lines of the sign do not converge consistently with the pole or the background building lines, suggesting a slight spatial incoherence in the 3D projection.
